description: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) of Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) systems under different conditions as the number of queries used during inference increases. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)" and is a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and is a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0. The plot includes four lines representing different DPR conditions: "DPR w/o query" is depicted by a black line with square markers, "DPR w/ corpus expansion" by a red line with circle markers, "DPR w/ document expansion" by a green line with triangle markers, and "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion" by a blue line with star markers. The "DPR w/o query" line remains relatively flat, starting and ending at approximately 35.0 MRR@10. The "DPR w/ corpus expansion" line shows a slight increase, starting at around 35.5 MRR@10 and ending at about 35.8 MRR@10. The "DPR w/ document expansion" line fluctuates slightly, starting at around 34.5 MRR@10 and ending at about 34.7 MRR@10. The "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion" line shows a gradual decline, starting at around 35.0 MRR@10 and ending at approximately 34.0 MRR@10.
